warning_source: Defense Ministry Adri Committee — professional committee on rabashatz operation/employment
recipient: Defense Ministry Director-General; senior IDF regional commanders asked for comment
warning_summary: Formal committee findings warned of unclear rabashatz authorities and command-and-control, inconsistent equipment/operational arrangements, inadequate training and readiness-maintenance gaps, with committee records stating rabashatzim said these deficiencies harmed their fitness/readiness.
evidence_state: State Comptroller report published 12 May 2026 reproduces the committee's 2023 process and states findings/recommendations were presented to the Defense Ministry director-general in September 2023. He approved them in principle and sought responses from relevant actors, including senior IDF regional commanders. Published to Notion as WARN-132 / High confidence / retrospective official evidence reproducing contemporaneous 2023 records.
gaps: Exact September date and full original committee report/distribution list are unpublished. No evidence that Defense Minister Gallant received the September report before Oct. 7; do not infer causation or that the warning was ignored.
